name: tty-esc-deny-preserves-earlier-steps
description: The original bug: a turn that already ran a completed tool call before a later call gets Esc-denied used to lose ALL of it. Now the denial ends the turn without another model call, and everything the turn already did - the completed call included - still commits.

steps.name: submit - the model calls list_dir first
screenContains: Enter to confirm · Esc to deny

steps.name: approve the first call with Enter
screenContains: Enter to confirm · Esc to deny

steps.name: deny the second call with Esc - the turn ends there
steps.waitFor: Stopped. Send a message to continue.
screenContains: Stopped. Send a message to continue.

steps.name: submit - the fixture's messageCount:4 matcher proves the completed list_dir call and the denial both survived, and its turn number that the model was not called in between
